title: License waits until the deployable image is hosted

costar.context: The maintainer said the license is the last thing, once shippin.tech is its own deployable product that can be pulled into shippin.cloud.
costar.objective: Record that order on the roadmap so the next phase is the deployable image, then hosting, and the license only after that.
costar.style: A roadmap phase and two rule sentences.
costar.audience: The next coding agent and the maintainer.
costar.response: deployable-product is the next phase, shippin-cloud depends on it, and license-choice depends on shippin-cloud.

concerns: The two-node cargo test is not a deployable image. Marking shippin-cloud next would skip the product the maintainer wants to see.
Zoho still waits until shippin.cloud hosts that image. It does not block the license, and the license does not wait on the client.
Dockerfile.fdb and resources/scale do not yet prove a mailbox across two running containers. That proof is the new phase, not this edit.
context: two-node-shared is done. The maintainer wants a product they can run, then pull into shippin.cloud, and only then a license.
current_state: license-choice had no dependencies, so an agent could write Cargo.toml before any deployable image existed. shippin-cloud depended directly on the in-process two-node test.
target_design: deployable-product depends on two-node-shared. shippin-cloud depends on deployable-product. license-choice and zoho-client both depend on shippin-cloud. Current work is the deployable image only.
changes: Point shippin-cloud at that phase and point license-choice at shippin-cloud.
Say the same order in product-boundaries.mdc and license-and-scale.mdc.
boundaries: Do not build the deployable image in this edit.
Do not add a client, an admin UI, or a second mail server.

verification.name: roadmap-order
verification.command: python -c "import json; r=json.load(open('.ai/modules/roadmap/data/roadmap.json')); p={x['id']:x for x in r['phases']}; assert p['deployable-product']['status']=='not_started'; assert p['deployable-product']['depends_on']==['two-node-shared']; assert p['shippin-cloud']['depends_on']==['deployable-product']; assert p['license-choice']['depends_on']==['shippin-cloud']; assert p['zoho-client']['depends_on']==['shippin-cloud']"
verification.proves: The license cannot be the next phase. The next phase is the deployable image, hosting depends on that image, and the license depends on hosting.

verification.name: module-check
verification.proves: The roadmap and the plan match their schemas. A broken phase record fails the whole tree.
